The Magmawiki skin is an altered version of the monobook skin designed to run as a test-drive of the draft skin for the [[df:Magmawiki|Magmawiki project]]. You can try it by going to [[Special:Preferences|"my preferences"]] and selecting it under the skins tab. Please leave comments, suggestions, ideas, etc... on the [[df talk: Magmawiki skin|talk page]].
